artworks.title: Hermes bearing the infant Dionysus (Parian marble, Archaeological Museum of Olympia)
artworks.description: The Cyllenian Hermes of Arcadia — born on Mount Cyllene, the peak named for both the hero Cyllen and the oread nymph Cyllene of Pelasgus' line — became one of the god's enduring cult titles. This celebrated marble from Olympia, long attributed to Praxiteles, shows the god as tender guardian; the mountain nymph who lent her name to his birthplace survives in prose rather than in monumental art.
